name: Firnovex Sync for ActiveCampaign
author: AI Digital Labs

sections.description:
You built a form. Maybe in Contact Form 7, maybe in Elementor, maybe it is hand-coded HTML in a theme template. Now you want everyone who fills it in to land in ActiveCampaign as a contact, on the right list, with the right tags, dropped into the right automation.

Normally that means paying for Zapier or Make, or hiring a developer to wire up webhooks. Firnovex Sync does it for you, from inside WordPress, for free.

How it works, in three steps

  1. It watches your forms. Firnovex Sync automatically lists every Contact Form 7 form. Any other form – WPForms, Gravity Forms, a page-builder form, a custom HTML form, a block form – is picked up the first time someone submits it.
  2. You map it once. Open a form, tell Firnovex Sync which field is the email address, which is the first name, and so on. Pick the tags to add, the lists to subscribe people to, and the automations to start. Flip it on.
  3. It syncs, quietly. From then on, every submission becomes an ActiveCampaign contact in the background. Your visitor never waits. If ActiveCampaign is slow or briefly down, Firnovex Sync retries automatically.

Works with

  • Contact Form 7 – listed automatically, no submission needed
  • Everything else – WPForms, Gravity Forms, Elementor, custom HTML, block forms, Divi, Bricks, Beaver Builder, Ninja Forms, Forminator and more, captured automatically on first submission
  • Pro add-on – native integrations for WPForms, Gravity Forms, Elementor and Fluent Forms that list your forms automatically before anyone has submitted them (a separate plugin, not required)

If it is a <form> on your site, Firnovex Sync can send it to ActiveCampaign.

What gets synced

  • Contact email, first name, last name and phone
  • Any ActiveCampaign custom field – full list pulled straight from your account
  • One or more tags (created for you if they do not exist yet)
  • One or more list subscriptions
  • One or more automations
  • A fixed value you type in, if you want every submission from a form to carry the same tag or field value

Built to be dependable

  • Nothing blocks the visitor. The form submits as normal; the ActiveCampaign call happens on a background job.
  • Automatic retries with backoff if the API errors or rate-limits.
  • Activity Log showing every submission, its status (synced, pending, failed, skipped) and the resulting contact, with a one-click Retry.
  • Replay – submissions collected before you finished mapping a form can be sent to ActiveCampaign in one click.
  • Uses Action Scheduler when it is available, falls back to WP-Cron otherwise.

Privacy and spam

  • A built-in honeypot and a per-IP rate limit drop obvious bot submissions before they ever reach ActiveCampaign.
  • An optional consent field – only sync a submission when a “I agree to…” checkbox was ticked.
  • Your ActiveCampaign API key is encrypted in the database, not stored in plain text.
  • You choose how long finished submission records are kept, and whether all plugin data is deleted on uninstall.

Third-party service

This plugin sends data to ActiveCampaign (https://<your-account>.api-us1.com), a third-party service, and only after you enter your own API URL and key on the Settings screen and switch a form mapping on.

What is sent: the mapped field values from a submission (such as name, email, phone and custom-field values) and the tag, list and automation choices you made for that form. Firnovex Sync also reads your account’s fields, lists, tags and automations so it can show them on the mapping screen.

  • ActiveCampaign Terms of Service: https://www.activecampaign.com/legal/terms-of-service
  • ActiveCampaign Privacy Policy: https://www.activecampaign.com/legal/privacy-policy

Not affiliated

Firnovex Sync for ActiveCampaign is an independent project. It is not created by, affiliated with, or officially endorsed by ActiveCampaign, LLC. “ActiveCampaign” is a trademark of ActiveCampaign, LLC.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to wp-content/plugins/, or install it from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Go to Firnovex Sync > Settings. In ActiveCampaign, open Settings > Developer and copy your API URL and API Key. Paste both in, click Test connection, then Save settings.
  4. Go to Firnovex Sync > Forms. Your Contact Form 7 forms are already listed. For any other form, submit it once on the front end and refresh.
  5. Click Map on a form. Match its fields to ActiveCampaign fields, choose tags / lists / automations, tick Enable syncing, and save.
  6. Done. Submissions now flow into ActiveCampaign. Watch them under Firnovex Sync > Activity Log.
sections.faq:
Do I need a paid ActiveCampaign plan?

Any ActiveCampaign plan works. Every plan includes API access, which is all Firnovex Sync needs.

My form plugin is not in the list. Will it still work?

Yes. Firnovex Sync lists Contact Form 7 forms automatically because that plugin lets it read its forms directly. Every other form – WPForms, Gravity Forms, page builders, custom HTML, block forms – is captured the first time it is submitted, then it appears on the Forms screen ready to map.

Will this slow down my website or my forms?

No. Firnovex Sync only records the submission during the request. The actual call to ActiveCampaign runs afterwards on a background job, so the person filling in your form never waits for it.

What happens to submissions from a form I have not mapped yet?

They are stored and marked “skipped”. When you finish mapping the form and enable it, tick the “sync the submissions already collected” box and they are all sent to ActiveCampaign.

What if ActiveCampaign is down or returns an error?

The submission stays in the queue and Firnovex Sync retries it automatically, with increasing gaps between attempts. You can also retry any submission by hand from the Activity Log.

Is it GDPR-friendly?

Firnovex Sync gives you the tools: an optional consent field so a submission only syncs when a checkbox was ticked, control over how long records are kept, and a “delete everything on uninstall” option. You are still responsible for your privacy policy and for how you use ActiveCampaign.

Where is my API key stored?

Encrypted, in your site’s options table, using a key derived from your WordPress security salts. It is never written to logs and never shown again in the admin after you save it.

Does it work with page caching / a CDN?

Yes. The universal capture script sends submissions as an anonymous request, so it does not depend on a logged-in session or a fresh nonce.

Does it work on WordPress Multisite?

Yes. Each site in the network has its own connection and its own form mappings.

Can one form add a contact to several lists or automations at once?

Yes. Tags, lists and automations are all multi-select on the mapping screen.

How do I send the same tag or value for every submission of a form?

Map that ActiveCampaign field or tag to a fixed value instead of a form field.
sections.changelog:
0.1.3

  • Fix: a custom HTML form that leaves some fields blank was listed on the Forms screen as several separate forms, one for each combination of filled-in fields. The plugin now recognises the form by its full set of fields, so all submissions go to one entry.
  • Fix: clicking Submit on a custom form that still has required fields empty is no longer captured as if it had been sent.

0.1.2

  • The author link in the plugins list now points to the author’s WordPress.org profile.

0.1.1

  • New Plans screen: compare Free, Personal and Agency, see which plan this site is on, and choose a Pro plan before going to checkout.
  • The dedicated WPForms, Gravity Forms and Elementor integrations now ship in the optional Pro add-on. Those forms are still captured by universal capture.
  • Fix: the Forms and Activity Log screens now use the same page styling as Settings.

0.1.0

  • Initial release.
  • Automatic form discovery for Contact Form 7, WPForms and Gravity Forms.
  • Universal capture for every other form via a lightweight front-end script.
  • Elementor Pro Forms detection.
  • Visual field mapping to ActiveCampaign contact fields, custom fields, tags, lists and automations.
  • Fixed-value mapping.
  • Background sync with automatic retries and a stalled-job sweeper.
  • Activity Log with manual retry and replay of pre-mapping submissions.
  • Honeypot, per-IP rate limiting and an optional consent field.
  • Encrypted API key storage; configurable data retention and uninstall cleanup.
